intentEvidence: Hadesr AI is an Obsidian plugin for AI-assisted writing.
problem: Writing requires constant context switching to external AI tools for editing, rewriting, or generating content.
summary: AI-assisted writing plugin that allows users to select text for rewriting, use inline completions, and execute 16 specialized writing actions via OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.
